Subject: Seniority smoothing and confidential transition plan

Team —

Attached is a proposal for a targeted restructure within the Serving Runtime + Platform pod where we smooth senior role boundaries and create a short confidential transition plan for a small set of role changes. High-level goals: lower single-point-of-failure risk for model release workstreams, preserve IC career ladders, and create a short runway (6–8 weeks) for sensitive handoffs to avoid public comms until HR is ready.

What I need from you this week:
- Aditya: review the org map and confirm technical coverage gaps (can you call out any subsystems that will need dedicated owners during the transition?)
- Lauren: draft a two-paragraph comms blurb for managers once HR signs off (avoid titles/comp specifics)
- Marcus: confirm list of ICs who should be offered temporary acting leads or mentorship (high risk / high impact)
- Monica: validate the transition checklist for payroll/comp/eligibility and confirm legal notices we need for managers to send.

This is confidential for now — please do not forward outside the recipients and the HR/legal CCs. I will sit down with Sam and Mercer later today to review compliance implications.

Attachments: 20260601-compact-pods-org-map-v1.pdf (diagram), 20260601-transition-checklist.xlsx (checklist)

Thanks,
Aisha

Hi all —

Quick legal note: temporary stipends are commonly used for interim responsibilities but they have to be documented and tracked as taxable compensation. If any acting lead will have materially different duties that affect exempt/non-exempt status or if the role will routinely make hiring/termination decisions, we should document authority levels and consider a short-term role addendum.

Also: for managers communicating sensitive changes, avoid language that could be construed as performance-based if this is primarily a scope/coverage change — keep it about "temporary coverage and continuity."

I recommend the following in the checklist:
- Written acting-lead agreement (2 weeks turnaround)
- Payroll stipend approval form (attached template)
- Manager one-pager for talking points (HR-reviewed)

Happy to join a short sync if you want to run through the checklist with Mercer.

Sam
EmploymentLaw LLP
